subject: Re: MedInnova demo — vendor portal prerequisites and calendar conflict
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medinnova.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@medinnova.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-14T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Scheduling a 45-min walkthrough (next week) — vendor onboarding items

Hi Jordan / Priya,

Thanks again for your time on the intro call — excited to show a short, targeted walkthrough of the Redwood inference flow for your use cases. Proposed slot: Wednesday 5/19 at 10:00am PT (45 min).

Before the demo the procurement team asked us to complete a couple quick items that will be required to actually run the live env test in your sandbox:
- Complete the vendor intake PDF (attached) and return
- Signed mutual NDA (Procurement requested copy on file)
- Short security questionnaire (they said they will send a link once intake is submitted)

If you can confirm Jordan / Priya that 5/19 at 10am PT still works for your team and that procurement will accept the attached vendor intake as the first step, I’ll hold the slot. If the procurement flow will not be completed by then, we can pick an alternative date.

Attachments: medinnova_vendor_form.pdf (vendor intake stub)

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference for production
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medinnova.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medinnova.com>, MedInnova Procurement <procurement@medinnova.com>
Date: 2027-05-15T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling a 45-min walkthrough (next week) — vendor onboarding items

Olga — thanks for the note and for sending the vendor intake PDF. Quick update from our side: procurement triaged this and we do need the intake uploaded to our vendor portal (not just the PDF returned) and a countersigned NDA in place before we can enable the sandbox access.

Priya (cc) will open the vendor portal ticket and send you a link for upload — we expect that to take 24–48 hours once we have the initial intake details. Given that, 5/19 at 10am PT is probably optimistic.

Jordan
Jordan Price
Director, Product Operations | MedInnova
jordan.price@medinnova.com | +1 212-555-0104

Olga — heads up, I’ll be traveling 5/18–5/20 for a partner summit and won’t have reliable access. If procurement needs the portal upload + NDA before we can enable the sandbox, we should not lock 5/19 as that will almost certainly get canceled from our side.

Suggested approach:
- Ask Priya to share the portal link and the expected SLA for intake processing — if the portal can accept the intake today and procurement can process in 24 hours, we could keep 5/21 or 5/24 open as alternatives.
- If portal processing looks longer, propose the week of 5/31 and I’ll make time to run the live environment check myself (I own the sandbox onboarding).

Laura — can you please block 5/31–6/3 afternoon slots tentatively for MedInnova? I’ll coordinate final availability after we hear back from procurement.

Marcus Lin

Hi Jordan / Priya — quick update from our side after Marcus’s travel note.

We completed the vendor intake and uploaded it to the portal this morning (attachment: medinnova_vendor_form.pdf — portal submission confirmation included in the Drive link), and I’ve attached a countersigned NDA for your records (signed-nda-olga.pdf). Thanks Priya for pushing the portal ticket.

Given Marcus is out 5/18–5/20 and we want him on the session for the sandbox check, can we reschedule the walkthrough to one of these options (all PT):
- Tue 5/25, 10:00–10:45
- Wed 5/26, 11:00–11:45
- Mon 5/31, 2:00–2:45

If procurement confirms sandbox enablement by EOD Monday (5/24) we can try 5/25; otherwise let’s target the week of 5/31.

Attaching: signed-nda-olga.pdf (signed mutual NDA)

Next steps / asks:
- Jordan / Priya: which of the proposed slots works?
- Procurement: please confirm estimated sandbox enablement after the portal upload so we know whether 5/25 is feasible.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov

olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
